plain_language_steps: Get the Notice of Claim form from the NYC Comptroller website or in person at 1 Centre Street, Room 1225, New York, NY 10007.
Fill out the form with your name, the date and location of the incident, how you were hurt, and the amount you are claiming.
File the completed form with the NYC Comptroller AND serve a copy on the New York City Transit Authority. You can file by mail, in person, or through the Comptroller's e-filing portal.
Keep a copy of everything you file, along with proof of the date you mailed or delivered it.
After filing, you will be scheduled for a hearing called a 50-H hearing where the city's lawyers will ask you questions under oath.
where_to_file: NYC Comptroller, 1 Centre Street, Room 1225, New York, NY 10007
